title: Lebesgue density for an arbitrary subset of an open set of finite measure
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, μ a Borel measure on ℝ^N, W ⊆ ℝ^N open with μ(W) < ∞, and A ⊆ W an arbitrary (not necessarily measurable) set. Let E be the set of x ∈ A such that μ(A ∩ B_r(x))/μ(B_r(x)) does not tend to 1 as r ↓ 0 (closed balls, limit along 𝓝[>] 0 in [0, ∞]). Then μ(E) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (W A : Set (Euclidean N)), IsOpen W → μ W ≠ ∞ → A ⊆ W → μ {x | x ∈ A ∧ ¬ Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => μ (A ∩ closedBall x r) / μ (closedBall x r)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1)} = 0
